content.title: About
content.content: Whole grain frozen pancakes are a ready‑to‑cook product made from whole‑grain flour, eggs, milk and a touch of sugar. They cook quickly on a skillet while retaining the nutritional benefits of whole grains and a pleasant aroma.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole‑grain pancakes contain more fiber than traditional white pancakes.
Freezing preserves most B‑vitamins and minerals when the product is properly packaged.
Many brands fortify whole‑grain pancakes with iron and folic acid to boost nutritional value.
In some countries they are sold in single‑serve packets designed for one or two portions.
Pancakes can be cooked without added oil using a non‑stick pan.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain flour provides dietary fiber that supports digestive health and promotes satiety.

items.title: Complex carbohydrates
items.content: Complex carbs release energy slowly, helping maintain stable blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2 and niacin are involved in energy metabolism and nervous‑system function.

items.title: Contains minerals
items.content: Pancakes supply iron, magnesium and zinc, which are important for blood formation and immunity.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: When cooked without added butter or oil, they remain a low‑calorie option.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: Whole‑grain flour contains gluten, making the product unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Some brands add a small amount of sugar; individuals monitoring blood sugar should check the label.

items.title: Possible additives
items.content: Preservatives or stabilizers may be present; those with sensitivities should choose additive‑free versions.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Thaw the pancakes in the microwave or at room temperature, then cook on a dry non‑stick skillet 1–2 minutes per side. Serve with berries, yogurt, nut butter or a light syrup.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen pancakes in their original packaging in a freezer at –18 °C. After opening, use within 3–4 days, returning them to a sealed container in the freezer.
